messages:
Alice M.: Kicking off a thread for the ACME edge-site bootstrap planning. This is a fully air-gapped 4xA100 rack with a VPC egress gateway. Need a concise preflight -> validation -> handoff runbook we can hand to the field ops team. Who's available to own?

Ben K.: I can own the infra checklist. High level preflight I want:
- Rack power and PDU load checked
- NICs + switch ports validated (link speed, autoneg off)
- GPUs visible and healthy
- Local mirror / registry seeded
- KMS/HSM reachability tests (if customer provided)

Ben K.: Quick commands to include:
```
# GPU health
nvidia-smi -q -x > /tmp/gpu-health.xml
# NIC link and offload
ethtool -i eth0 && ethtool -k eth0
# simple perf
python -m pip install mlperf-inference || true
```

Carla P.: For air-gapped image delivery: two options we use in the field - "usb-boot" and "local-registry-mirror". Document both. Example registry bootstrap (on ops laptop connecting to local temporary switch):
```
docker run -d --restart=always -p 5000:5000 \
  -v /data/registry:/var/lib/registry \
  -e REGISTRY_STORAGE_DELETE_ENABLED=true \
  registry:2
# push images from laptop -> USB disk -> import on site
```

Carla P.: Also include steps for package repo mirror (apt/yum) and how to flip k8s node image pulls to the local registry. Keep commands minimal.

Dmitri R.: Networking validation notes:
- MTU should be 9000 across host -> TOR -> aggregation. Add mtu check: `ip link show dev eth0`
- If customer uses BGP, verify peer configs and ASNs; bring a simple BGP neighbor test script.
- iperf3 is our friend for path validation: `iperf3 -c <peer> -P 10 -t 30`

Dmitri R.: Example BGP check (bird/quagga):
```
# quick grep for AS and neighbor
sudo cat /etc/bird/bird.conf | grep -E "neighbor|remote-as"
# session check
birdc6 show protocols
```

Alice M.: Great. Add a validation run (30m window) we will run after base OS + kube installed:
1) GPU smoke: run a short CUDA matrix multiply job (2min) across all GPUs.
2) Inference smoke: launch a tiny mlperf-like container and do 50 inferences.
3) Network: iperf3 baseline and 4x 100G path sanity (if available).
4) Storage: write/read 10GB at target filesystem layer (nvme -> ceph/local).

Alice M.: Also need error escalation steps if GPU fails N health check (who to call, spare node rotation). Add spares + serial console steps.

Ben K.: I'll put spare rotation as: mark node unschedulable, drain, apply taint, update routing in HAProxy for model routing. Snippet: `kubectl cordon <node>` / `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets`

infra-bot: Checklist template attached: preflight -> seed -> validate -> handoff. Fields: site_id, rack_id, ops_contact, power_checks, mtus, bgp_status, local_registry_url, gpu_serials, validation_logs_url. Use this as the canonical handoff artifact.

Carla P.: Security notes: customer KMS certs must be imported into the local keystore before we start services that talk to HSM. Command: `openssl pkcs12 -in customer.p12 -out customer.pem -nodes` then import into `/etc/keystore` per SOP.

Dmitri R.: Cost/ops flag: confirm we set GPU allocation quotas in the private cluster to avoid accidental overcommit. Suggest default tenancy pool: reserved=3, burst=1 for this 4xA100 setup. Add quota snippet in terraform/k8s quota yaml.

Ben K.: I'll author the runbook doc and put it in the private-runbooks folder, then ping @eng-oncall for review. Aim to have draft by EOD tomorrow.

Alice M.: Perfect. Schedule validation window for Friday 09:00 customer local time. Ben, please add a short 'what to expect' note for the ops handoff (expected timelines, who performs which test).

Ben K.: Will do. tagging: @Carla P. for image steps, @Dmitri R. for networking, @Alice M. for final signoff. :thumbsup:
